inputs.modified_text:
Look at the chaos unfolding in France right now. The progressive, secular establishment is launching a direct assault on our civilizational foundations by targeting Father Bernard Domini, superior of the Missionary Family of Notre-Dame (FMND), under a disgraceful new law targeting “psychological subjection.” 

Make no mistake, this overreaching modern state is not about protecting people; it is a calculated attack on traditional faith, family, and religious authority. When they criminalize traditional religious hierarchy and spiritual guidance under vague, modern pretexts, they are actively tearing down the moral fabric that holds our society together. This outrage against the natural order and true religious freedom proves once again why we must stand up and defend our traditional institutions, authority, and cultural continuity from these progressive bureaucrats before it is too late.
